summary: Frontend-only test at desktop 1920x1080. Created an ephemeral Firebase user with 5 TEST_Iter60 pratiche: avvolgibile with molle config (schema continuità 0.15 Ohm, isolamento 250, diff 22 ms, cavo typed 'FG160R16'), avvolgibile tubolare, sezionale, tapparella and scorrevole. Also created 1 Solo CE and 1 Registro. Downloaded 16 PDFs via the UI: the full PDF for each of the 5 pratiche, single dm37/ce/registro/targhetta/collaudo/registro_righe/fascicolo, Solo CE, Solo Registro, and the blank StampaVuoto avvolgibile full PDF. Checked them with PyMuPDF (numbering, overlaps, right margin, content) and visually. PASS: global footer 'Pagina X di 19' appears exactly once per page, X runs 1..19 with no repeats, TOT is correct, and the left title 'Italserrande S.r.l. — <doc>' carries (i/n) for multi-page docs. The CE (2 pages) and Registro primo intervento use y≈822 with no old internal 'Pagina 1 di 2'/'1 di 1' and no overlap with signatures. Single-document PDFs read 'Pagina 1 di N' consistently. Solo CE and Solo Registro keep their original footers. The Targhetta note about poliestere/resina and trasferimento termico is present and the old carta adesiva/plastificare text is gone. DM37 PASS: 'Il sottoscritto', 'Camera di Commercio (C.C.I.A.A.) di Roma n. 1152580', the 4 tipo checkboxes on 2 columns without overlap, and FG16OR16 is auto-corrected. The verifiche strumentali table shows 'Conforme - 0.15 Ohm', '250 MOhm' and '22 ms', and '______ Ohm' when the value is empty or blank. The form field 'Continuità PE (Ohm)' is present and editable. Periodicità is uniformly 12 mesi privato / 6 mesi condominiale/commerciale/intensivo, with no other 'mesi' values. CE avvertenza 7 CPR/DoP, norme row 7 'Reg. (UE) 305/2011 (CPR) - DoP' and the fascicolo CPR row are present. Config serranda: pratica-config-serranda is shown only for avvolgibile (not sezionale/tapparella). The collaudo item 'Molle di bilanciamento' shows with molle or no config (blank) and is hidden with tubolare, in both form and PDF. 'Elettrofreno' shows for avvolgibile and tapparella only. Zero console errors or pageerrors. FAIL / REGRESSION: the fascicolo is now 5 pages instead of 4 (iter59). Page 3 is a near-empty '(segue)' page with only the A.3 table header plus 1 row ('Kit batterie tampone'), in every pratica (all tipi, filled and blank, single and full). Minor issues: (1) in the CE avvertenze, items 5 and 7 overrun the right margin (x=555 and 562 vs margin 544). (2) In the Registro manutenzioni a righe header, 'Tipo' breaks mid-word into 'Tip'/'o' because the 26pt column is too narrow; the headers do not overlap, but it looks wrong.

ui_bugs.component: praticaPdf.js fascicolo Allegato A.3 / page layout
ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION: the fascicolo is 5 pages (was 4 in iter59). Page 3 holds only '(segue)', the A.3 Componenti header and 1 row ('Kit batterie tampone', last y=93). Likely cause: the new CPR/DoP row in section 5 (and/or the taller wrapped table headers) pushes A.3 past BOTTOM by one row. Affects every pratica and the blank form, so the full PDF grows to 19 pages.

Items 5 (Manutenzione programmata...) and 7 (Per le porte UNI EN 13241... DoP, ove applicabile.) are single-line p.text at 8.8pt and end at x=555 and 562, past the 544.2 right margin. They should wrap with splitTextToSize or be shortened. The avvertenze still do not overlap the signature boxes (last line y≈332, box label at 346).

The 'Tipo' column (26pt) is too narrow, so the header breaks mid-word as 'Tip' / 'o'. 'Firma tecnico' wraps while 'Firma cliente' does not. Widen Tipo to about 32pt (taking width from Descrizione), or use 'T.'.

issues: Both header columns read 'Allegato'. The second should be 'Presente' / 'Esito'.

action_items: Bring the fascicolo back to 4 pages and remove the near-empty page 3 '(segue)' with the single A.3 row. Options: make A.3 fit (shrink row height/padding or the section 5 note), give section 5 a smaller keep, or move the Dal 20 gennaio 2027 note. Re-run iter59_layout_check.py on /tmp/iter60.
Wrap or shorten CE avvertenze 5 and 7 so they stay within x ≤ 544.
Widen the 'Tipo' column in the Registro manutenzioni a righe so the header does not break mid-word.
Optional: rename the second 'Allegato' column header in DM37 Allegati obbligatori.
critical_code_review_comments: documentiPdf.js drawCe writes CE_AVVERTENZE with fixed y = 251 + i*13.5 and no wrapping, so any longer avvertenza overflows the margin or the signature boxes. Use splitTextToSize and an accumulated y.
Flow.table header height is now 7 + lines*10 for every repeated header, and table() only reserves 24 + rows*22 for ≤6 rows. Fascicolo pagination is fragile with no slack, as the 1-row spill shows.
checklistFor hides 'molle' only when tipo === 'avvolgibile' and cfg is set; sezionale/basculante always show molle, which is intended.

The CE avvertenza 7 (CPR/DoP for UNI EN 13241 doors) is also printed for tapparella (UNI EN 13659). The wording 'Per le porte UNI EN 13241' makes this acceptable, but it could be hidden for tapparella.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: python iter55_ui_setup.py setup, then python iter60_create.py (ids in /tmp/iter60_ids.json). Download via UI to /tmp/iter60 with an init script that sets navigator.share/canShare to undefined: documento-row-<id> → pratica-share-all, pratica-pdf-<k>; documenti-tab-ce/manutenzione → documento-share; stampa-vuoto-toggle/tipo/documento/scarica. Then run iter60_pdf_check.py (footers, overlaps, margin), iter60_content_check.py, and iter59_layout_check.py with the glob changed to /tmp/iter60. Finish with iter55_ui_setup.py cleanup. 'Pagina X di 1[0-9]' contains 'Pagina 1 di 1' as a substring, so use the regex in content_check. The '1/2026' past-margin hit on the registro is the original Nr. box design, not a bug.
rca of the issue: Fascicolo 5 pages: Allegato A is inline on page 2, and the A.3 Componenti table (12 rows) now ends exactly one row below BOTTOM=786. Flow.table calls ensure(h) for that last row, adds a page, and repeats the header there. The extra height most likely comes from the new section 5 CPR/DoP row (+1 table row ≈ 16pt) added in this iteration, possibly combined with the new header height formula.
